originalTitle: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
content: We made a billing mistake at launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage for most users.
